memory.title_zh: DMEM + TTM/IGT 把 VRAM pressure/reclaim 推进为可验证的 KMD capability
memory.title_en: DMEM + TTM/IGT make VRAM pressure/reclaim a verifiable KMD capability
memory.impact_zh: 将 accounting、protection、reclaim mechanism、eviction selection 与 QoS policy 分层；在 recoverable fault/HMM P0 之后，把 VRAM Pressure + Reclaim/Eviction Contract 提升为 Memory P1。
memory.impact_en: Separate accounting, protection, reclaim mechanism, eviction selection and QoS policy; after recoverable-fault/HMM P0, promote VRAM Pressure + Reclaim/Eviction Contract to Memory P1.
memory.priority_zh: P1；fault/HMM 第一版稳定后立即立项
memory.priority_en: P1; start after the first fault/HMM correctness loop

memory.title_zh: Xe CPU-bind + ULLS migration queue 将 page-fault latency 作为独立性能目标
memory.title_en: Xe CPU-bind + ULLS migration queue treats page-fault latency as a first-class target
memory.impact_zh: fault measurement contract 应覆盖 IRQ→resolve→migration/bind→PTE→TLB→replay 的分段延迟；correctness 稳定后再评估专用低延迟 migration/bind path。
memory.impact_en: Measure IRQ→resolve→migration/bind→PTE→TLB→replay latency by stage; evaluate a dedicated low-latency migration/bind path only after correctness is stable.

virt.title_zh: Xe VF migration 向 multi-queue 扩展，强化可序列化 GPU resource state 的需求
virt.title_en: Xe VF migration extends toward multi-queue, strengthening the need for serializable GPU resource state
virt.impact_zh: PF/VF 第一版就应为 VM/page-table、queue-group、doorbell/IRQ、FW scheduler/resource、VRAM 与 recovery generation 建立 stable logical ID 和 serialize/restore boundary。
virt.impact_en: Early PF/VF design should define stable logical IDs and serialize/restore boundaries for VM/page tables, queue groups, doorbells/IRQs, FW scheduler/resources, VRAM and recovery generations.
virt.priority_zh: 架构 P1；完整 live migration 后续
virt.priority_en: Architecture P1; full live migration later

power.title_zh: AMDGPU UCLK DPM 修复说明 capability 不等于当前阶段可安全启用
power.title_en: AMDGPU UCLK DPM fix shows capability does not imply safe enablement at the current phase
power.impact_zh: PM/FW interface 要区分 capability、dependency readiness、safe enable phase、ACK、post-enable validation 与 rollback；继续 measurement/lifetime-first。
power.impact_en: PM/FW interfaces should distinguish capability, dependency readiness, safe enable phase, ACK, post-enable validation and rollback while remaining measurement/lifetime-first.
power.priority_zh: 当前 PM/FW interface 设计

ras.title_zh: Xe cold-reset recovery 将 RAS 从 reset gate 推进到 recovery scope / escalation
ras.title_en: Xe cold-reset recovery pushes RAS from a reset gate toward recovery scope/escalation
ras.impact_zh: 统一定义 context/queue/engine/FW/device-warm/PCI/cold-reset/permanent-failure 层级，并为每级明确 handle validity、VRAM preservation、replay 与 userspace cooperation。
ras.impact_en: Define context/queue/engine/FW/device-warm/PCI/cold-reset/permanent-failure levels with explicit handle validity, VRAM preservation, replay and userspace-cooperation semantics.

ras.title_zh: AMDGPU gfx1150 regression 强调验证 recovery outcome 和故障 containment，而不只是 reset 是否执行
ras.title_en: AMDGPU gfx1150 regression reinforces validating recovery outcomes and containment, not merely reset execution
ras.impact_zh: fault-injection matrix 要验证一个 context fault 是否扩散到 MES/KFD/device，并记录 fault scope × recovery scope × unaffected queues × post-reset admission。
ras.impact_en: Fault-injection should verify whether a context fault spreads into MES/KFD/device and record fault scope × recovery scope × unaffected queues × post-reset admission.

obs.title_zh: DRM_RAS netlink / error threshold / structured SIGID 推动 GPU error observability 形成稳定 schema
obs.title_en: DRM_RAS netlink / error threshold / structured SIGID push GPU error observability toward a stable schema
obs.impact_zh: stable error_id/object identity/severity/source/timestamp/generation/counter/threshold/recovery-result 应成为 trace/eBPF/devcoredump/FW log/management event 共用的数据模型。
obs.impact_en: Stable error ID/object identity/severity/source/timestamp/generation/counter/threshold/recovery result should be shared across trace/eBPF/devcoredump/FW logs/management events.

fw.title_zh: Xe mailbox PHASE 修复强调 protocol state 必须有唯一 authoritative truth source
fw.title_en: Xe mailbox PHASE fix reinforces having one authoritative truth source for protocol state
fw.impact_zh: 对 producer/consumer index、phase/epoch、seq、generation、capability snapshot 明确 ownership；reset/reconnect 时定义 reread、re-handshake、regenerate 与 stale-completion 规则。
fw.impact_en: Define ownership for producer/consumer indices, phase/epoch, sequence, generation and capability snapshots; reset/reconnect must specify reread, re-handshake, regenerate and stale-completion rules.
fw.priority_zh: 当前 Firmware protocol 第一版
